description: This file defines the ChargeWritePlatformService interface for handling charge-related operations such as create, update, and delete within the Fineract application.

classes.name: ChargeWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods for creating, updating, and deleting charges on the platform.

methods.name: createCharge
methods.description: Creates a new charge using the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateCharge
methods.description: Updates an existing charge identified by chargeId with data from the JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteCharge
methods.description: Deletes the charge identified by chargeId.
